title: Juicy Crisp French Feta Confit
description: A winey, crisp, and cozy French dish featuring cubed feta cheese and bonito flakes, perfect for a cold winter evening, and is dairy-free friendly by using non-dairy alternatives.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cube the feta cheese into 1-inch pieces and set aside.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the thyme, bay leaves, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the cubed feta cheese and stir gently to coat with the oil and spices.
Add the red wine and bring to a simmer.
Cover the Dutch oven with a lid and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 20 minutes, then remove the lid and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the cheese is crispy on top.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with bonito flakes.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh thyme if desired.
